title: Enrich company domains with Clay HTTP API
baseUrlInstructions: Copy the actual HTTPS API gateway origin from your marketplace subscription. No live RapidAPI or JoJAPI URL is assumed.

queryParameters.name: domain
queryParameters.valueSource: Select the Domain column with Clay's column picker

authentication.storage: Use an encrypted Clay HTTP API (Headers) account; never paste a key into a public table or this JSON file.

rapidapi.additionalHeaderValueSource: Hostname from the subscribed gateway origin

vatMode: For direct validation, choose /v1/eu-vat-validator and replace domain with vat mapped from a country-prefixed VAT number column.
outputHandling: Keep the complete response, including success, partial, warnings, evidence and cache fields when present. An upstream error or missing evidence is not a negative legal finding.
billing: Each request follows the subscribed marketplace plan. Clay usage is separate. Disable automatic retries until you have assessed the plan's billing behavior.
